title: Local style with a 1-char label (PHP rejects: class_name_too_short → ATOMIC_STYLES_INVALID)
_comment: Seed [R8] TYPED-ENVELOPE regression (WP-F06). Every prop here is a correctly-typed envelope and the local-style id is mirrored into classes (R4/§5.1), so the tree is STRUCTURALLY well-formed (passes element-node/style-variant schema validation). BUT the local-style `label` is "l" — below the min length the live Style_Parser enforces (spike-verified "label: class_name_too_short", SUMMARY.md R8), so PHP dry_run throws "Styles validation failed for style ..." → ATOMIC_STYLES_INVALID (has-atomic-base.php:97, 12-error-taxonomy.md §3.1). prefilter.verdict:defer — label length is not in the TS structural subset (it defers style validity to PHP, §4); defer on an invalid fixture is permitted by the meta-invariant.
